default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-528.title: One-sliver poke fade
E-528.hypothesis: A bar that pokes only a sliver beyond the previous bar's extreme and closes back against the prior close shows stop orders just beyond the extreme found no follow-through; fade the poke.

E-529.title: Prior-session open recross follow
E-529.hypothesis: The previous session's opening price is a reference many participants remember; a close back across it after a long stay on one side flips the sentiment of yesterday's openers, follow the cross.

E-530.title: Fading-volume run fade
E-530.hypothesis: A run of closes in one direction while each bar trades less volume than the last means the push lacks participation; liquidity providers fade it.

E-531.title: Session signed-volume share cross follow
E-531.hypothesis: The share of the session's volume traded in up bars minus down bars summarises who has been the aggressor all day; when it crosses a threshold the day's inventory holders are on one side, follow.

E-532.title: Event-minute heavy bar follow
E-532.hypothesis: A bar with volume far above its usual same-minute level is a scheduled-or-news event; the informed flow behind it keeps pushing in the bar's direction.

E-533.title: Closing-hours VWAP-side breakout follow
E-533.hypothesis: In the last hours, a market that has stayed on one side of VWAP and makes a fresh short-term extreme has benchmark (VWAP) buyers or sellers still to execute before the close; follow.

E-534.title: Elder-Ray power hook in an EMA trend
E-534.hypothesis: In a rising EMA trend, bear power (low minus EMA) turning up from its recent low marks sellers losing the pullback; buy the hook, sell the mirror in a falling trend.

E-535.title: Counter-colour run on the VWAP side resumption
E-535.hypothesis: Several counter-trend closes that never lose the VWAP are a shallow pullback inside the side that institutions defend; the first bar back with the trend resumes it.

E-536.title: Wyckoff no-supply / no-demand test
E-536.hypothesis: A narrow, low-volume down bar inside an uptrend (no supply) shows sellers have dried up; the mirror no-demand bar in a downtrend; trade with the trend.

E-537.title: Low-overlap thrust fade
E-537.hypothesis: Consecutive bars barely overlapping mean one side took liquidity aggressively; such thrusts overshoot and partly revert once the urgent flow is done.
